_readme: Copy this file to config/safety_limits.json and fill in limits verified from YOUR plant's own SOPs, equipment datasheets, or the actual applicable standard for your machine class. AEGIS never invents these numbers — leave a check's block out (or its limits null) and the agent will only apply it when a query or retrieved SOP text states the limit explicitly. 'source' is a citation you fill in, not something AEGIS checks.
